attBesluta.text: Easy to put together. Very sturdy  perfect size to start myself off gardening

Ich fang mal beim Service (Verkäufer) an : der Verkäufer ist Top !!! Alle Probleme werden gelöst !Jetzt zum Gewächshaus : Die Qualität ist echt gut ! Nur die Aufbauanleitung ist leider nicht so gut !Wenn man es endlich aufgebaut hat dann sieht das schon sehr gut aus !!! Würde ich immer wieder kaufen -
Excellent packaging well put together greenhouse put it up by myself they even thought about rubber covers for screws that stick through the frame so you don't catch yourself on them
Description was spot on, delivery was rapid great value for money. Took a while to assemble that’s because it was freezing and I couldn’t feel my fingers. Would recommend
It took 3 days to erect. Lots of fiddly screw and nuts to do. Instructions are good and fairly easy to follow. Now I'm happy in my happy greenhouse.

The product was delivered within a couple of days of placing the order.  I found the instructions fairly easy to follow and put the greenhouse together by myself over a couple of days.  I am pleased with the quality of the finished product.
Excellent green house very sturdy once put together instructions a little bit confusing but a great solid greenhouse once constructed
Produit bien pensé. Il faut faire preuve de patience et de méthodologie pour bien monter la serre. Quelques schémas sont à interpréter façon meuble danois...
